official_product_identity: 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables, official table-based Summary File, B11001
source_geography_and_type: National table-based Detailed Tables file, deterministically filtered to Census tract GEO_ID values beginning 1400000US55 for Wisconsin tract household evidence.

retrieval.method: HTTPS GET of the exact source_reference URL; select the exact pipe-delimited B11001 source file rather than an API latest/current alias.
retrieval.access_surface_reason: The official ACS API required an API key when DATA-02 was materialized. This exact official Detailed Tables distribution is the smallest compatible non-authenticated source file and is not a source/vintage substitution.

request_identity.access_surface: official ACS table-based Summary File HTTPS distribution
request_identity.geography_selection: Rows whose GEO_ID begins exactly 1400000US55; no inferred market or target filtering.

request_hash_semantics: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for request_identity: recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, Unicode preserved, no NaN.
checksum_semantics: Controlling checksum is SHA-256 over exact raw acsdt5y2024-b11001.dat bytes before row filtering, parsing, normalization, or conversion. It is distinct from request_sha256 and manifest_content_sha256.

expected_file_properties.container: UTF-8-compatible pipe-delimited text with one header row

annotation_and_special_value_contract.source_file_annotation_state: The selected official table-based file has no annotation columns. Its raw estimate and MOE tokens must be preserved losslessly; absence of an annotation column must produce annotation=null, never an implied valid/zero value.
annotation_and_special_value_contract.required_parser_behavior: Keep raw estimate and MOE tokens separate from parsed values and status. Missing, non-numeric, suppressed, inapplicable, or other invalid evidence must remain distinguishable, must retain the source token/provenance, and must not become zero. A downstream use requiring API annotations must retrieve and pin those annotation fields separately; this DATA-02 manifest does not invent them.

reproduction: Download exactly source_reference as bytes, require exact filename, byte length, header fields, and source-byte SHA-256. Parse as specified in request_identity, require source field presence, then select only the exact GEO_ID prefix. Recalculate request_sha256 from request_identity and manifest_content_sha256 using the stated canonical JSON semantics.
failure_behavior: Fail closed on unavailable source, product/vintage/filename mismatch, byte-length or source-byte checksum mismatch, header/schema mismatch, missing B11001 estimate or MOE field, unexpected geography identity, malformed records, or invalid/missing required metadata. Do not use latest/current, a different ACS vintage, a different product, a substituted API response, or a zero default.
attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-Year Detailed Tables, table B11001.

lineage.controlling_decision: DATA-01: Accepted Public Data Source Decisions
lineage.model_boundary: B11001 is source household evidence only; DATA-02 does not define MODEL transformations, thresholds, weights, aggregation, or scoring.

supersession_policy: A correction or a newly accepted release requires a new manifest ID/version and explicit supersedes lineage; never overwrite this accepted manifest.
